title: 第十二章 药材
slug: 民国我包国维黄埔一期
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

六块大洋到手。

加上原本还有的九块，目前身家十五大洋。

脑子里的文章有不少，但不想一次性投那么多出去，就像刚刚编辑所说的，名声太小，单价给的就过低，等养养笔名单价变高了，再投，那时赚的也就更多一些。

想着十五块大洋该如何去花，目前最想买的是自行车。

就像今天十几公里的距离，要是有个自行车就会方便很多，大大节省了时间，做事更加高效。

可自行车过于昂贵，十五块大洋估计也就够买一个轮胎的。

在附近街面上找了一家酒馆走了进去。

赚了一笔钱，得好好犒劳下自己。

黄埔的伙食并不是太好，现在过来改善改善。

大中午的，酒楼的客人不在少数。

跑堂小厮连忙过来给包国维安排了个桌子：“先生要吃点什么？”

酒楼整的挺时髦，桌子上还有一份菜单子。

十六岁的年纪，正是最能吃的时候，包国维感觉自己还在长身体。再加上军校成天的训练，身体素质不断地加强，确实需要不少的能量补充：“你们这的招牌烧鹅来一份，乳猪小份，清蒸鱼，猪肚鸡，再来一壶酒。”

“客人，这您点的有些多了，一个人吃的完吗？”

“只管上就好了。”

包国维有这个自信。

点了一桌子的菜，四五个人的分量，他一个人就能全部解决掉。

广州的美食比较的清淡，注重原味。

军校里头吃饭养成的习惯，现在吃的也很快，那么多的食物，逐渐的给它消灭掉。

结算了两块大洋，主要是那条清蒸鱼的食材比较昂贵，占了一半的价钱。

两块大洋，节省点足够吃上一个月了。

不过目前包国维有来钱的渠道，倒也不用在乎这些。

一分钱一分货，吃的够香。

被旁边桌子上的两个给盯上了：“哥，瞧瞧他，人家的下酒菜，一人吃那么多，再看看咱，一荤一素一花生米配酒。

孤身一人，穿着也不差，哥，我想干他。”

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

Got six ocean dollars.

Including the original nine yuan, he is currently worth fifteen thousand yuan.

I have a lot of articles in my mind, but I don’t want to invest so many at once. As the editor just said, if the reputation is too small, the unit price given is too low. When the list price of Yangyangbi becomes higher, I will invest again, and then I will earn more.

Thinking about how to spend fifteen yuan, what I want to buy most right now is a bicycle.

Just like the distance of more than ten kilometers today, it will be much more convenient if you have a bicycle, which greatly saves time and makes things more efficient.

But bicycles are too expensive. Fifteen dollars is probably enough to buy a tire.

I found a pub on a nearby street and went in.

After making some money, you have to treat yourself well.

The food in Huangpu is not very good, now come here to improve it.

At noon, there were many customers in the restaurant.

The waiter quickly came over and arranged a table for Bao Guowei: "What would you like to eat, sir?"

The restaurant is very stylish and there is a menu on the table.

At the age of sixteen, it is the time when he can eat the most. Bao Guowei feels that he is still growing.Coupled with the all-day training at the military academy, my physical fitness is constantly improving, and I really need a lot of energy replenishment: "Have a portion of your signature roast goose, a small portion of suckling pig, steamed fish, pork belly chicken, and a bottle of wine."

"Guest, you ordered too much. Can you finish it by yourself?"

"Just get on it."

Bao Guowei has this confidence.

After ordering a table of dishes for four or five people, he could handle them all by himself.

Guangzhou’s food is relatively light and focuses on original flavor.

The habit of eating in the military academy was now eaten very quickly, and so much food was gradually eliminated.

We settled for two yuan, mainly because the ingredients for the steamed fish were relatively expensive, accounting for half of the price.

Two oceans, enough to save for a month.

But now Bao Guowei has channels to make money, so he doesn't need to worry about this.

You get what you pay for, and the food is delicious.

He was stared at by the two people at the table next to him: "Brother, look at him, he eats so many dishes to go with wine, and look at us, one meat, one vegetable and one peanut to go with the wine.

Alone and well-dressed, bro, I want to fuck him."
